summary: Window Water Baby Moving is an experimental short film by Stan Brakhage, shot in November 1958 and released in 1959. It documents the birth of the director's first child, Myrrena. The film was shot by Brakhage while his then-wife Jane Brakhage, now Jane Wodening, gave birth.
one_line: Stan Brakhage's 1959 experimental short film documenting the birth of his first child, Myrrena.
key_facts: Window Water Baby Moving is an experimental short film by Stan Brakhage.
The film was filmed in November 1958.
The film documents the birth of the director's first child, Myrrena.
The birth documented in the film was of Myrrena, Stan Brakhage's first child.
Jane Brakhage was the then-wife of director Stan Brakhage.
Jane Brakhage is now known as Jane Wodening.
The film documents the birth experienced by Jane Brakhage.
The note describes the work as an experimental short film.
